{{Quote|You left. You don't know anything. This should have been my fight, my chance at greatness. But you stole it from me. Again.|Ri'kan Kateen to his sister Sa'har|<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref>}}
'''Ri'kan Kateen''', known to the Hidden Chain as '''Hibir of Heta Kol''',<ref name="sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Hidden Chain Ship}}</ref> was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived at the [[Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], and later in life became a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and a member of the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="digging" />

==Biography==
===Childhood===
[[File:RikanKateenChildhood.png|thumb|200px|Kateen as a child]]
Years before the [[third Galactic War]], Ri'kan and his younger sister [[Sa'har Kateen]] were both orphaned at a young age. Both spent their earliest years at the Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children, an orphanage located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] of [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Sa'har Kateen}}</ref> Sometime later, both began to show signs of Force-sensitivity, though Ri'kan's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was not as strong as his sister's. At some point, Sa'har was taken by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denolm Orr]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but she was forced to leave Ri'kan behind due to her brother's weaker connection to the Force.<ref name="Disorder" />

===Becoming a Mandalorian===
[[File:Rikan_Kateen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ri'kan Kateen]]
Ri'kan would become a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and a member of the [[Hidden Chain]] long before the start of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Two years before the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|battle]] between the Hidden Chain and Shae Vizla's forces, Ri'kan and his group were hired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for a mission where they encountered a team of Mandalorians, hired by the Republic and led by Layla Ordo. The teams clashed with one another, resulting in causalities on both sides that included Layla. Ri'kan escape, having failed the Empire's mission. He personally blamed Clan Ordo mainly due to losing some of Heta's best people, which he prioritized over the Empire.<ref name="showdown">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>

===Reunion with Sa'har===
[[File:RikanKateen-LotS.png|thumb|right|200px|Ri'kan is released from his cell by Sa'har.]]
During the Third Galactic War, Ri'kan was captured by the Mandalorians and was unexpectedly rescued by his sister: Sa'har Kateen. Ri'kan did not acknowledge her nor showed any interest in Sa'har's attempts at reconciling with each other. Ri'kan defensively stated that she had left him and now he did not need her. After one last desperate act from Sa'har, Ri'kan relented by telling her that although he did not need her, he knew of someone who could use her and instructed her to follow him and not ask any questions. Ri'kan then took Sa'har to the [[Hidden Chain]]'s base of operations, reunited with [[Heta Kol]] and introduced his sister to his comrades.<ref name="digging">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

During their "partnership" in the Hidden Chain, Sa'har informed Ri'kan that she was in the possession of a Sith holocron belonging to [[Darth Nul]] and that [[Darth Malgus]] was seeking it. She also informed him that the holocron was the key to a powerful weapon.<ref name="showdown" />

===Showdown on Ruhnuk===
[[File:RikanSaharKateen-LegacyOfTheSith.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ri'kan brings Sa'har to meet with Heta Kol.]]
On Ruhnuk, Ri'kan ventured out to meetup with a [[Clan Varad]] patrol guarding a signal tower and chastises the two that if they didn't report in then it would him come out and make Clan Varad look bad. When one arrogantly stated that they answered to the Field Marshal rather than Ri'kan, Ri'kan then punched him and told the other to educate his fellow recruit and then departed.<ref name="signals" /> Later on, Ri'kan was on a holocall with Sa'har until Sa'har was interrupted unexpectedly which ended the call prematurely. Ri'kan once again contacted Sa'har and asked her to bring the holocron back with her until the call was once again interrupted by Shae shooting it.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Outside Interference|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

[[File:Rikan_Kateens_helmet.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ri'kan Kateen in his full Mandalorian armor]]
Ri'kan was present with Heta Kol and a few Hidden Chain members when they confronted the [[Alliance Commander]] immobilized by four sonic disruptors courtesy of [[Bask Sunn]]. Ri'kan also drew his blade when Shae angrily confronted Heta only to stop with Heta's command. After Heta and Shae headed for the arena, Ri'kan knocked out the Commander and ordered the Dar'manda to take care of them and anything else would be blamed on Dar'manda. In the arena, Ri'kan listened to Heta's speech on what separates them from the rest of the Mandalorians, witnessed Shae's arrival and to start the duel, Ri'kan softly smashed his fist into his chest with the rest of the Hidden Chain following suit.<ref name="showdown" />

[[File:Rikan_Kateen_challenges_Rass_Ordo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ri'kan Kateen challenges Rass Ordo amidst the battle.]]
After the duel, Ri'kan took part in the battle between the Hidden Chain and Shae's forces where he dispatched several Mandalorians and recognized [[Rass Ordo]] to which he began targeting him only to be held off by Rass's blaster rifle. But when the rifle was depleted of ammo, Ri'kan took the opportunity to injure Rass with his large vibrosword and when he moved in to finish off Rass, he was attacked by the Alliance Commander who relentlessly attacked Ri'kan only to be saved by Sa'har who pushed the Commander away using the Force and then the two rocket boosted to an [[Eternal Empire shuttle]] and waited for Heta to join them before departing Ruhnuk with their fleet.<ref name="showdown" />

[[File:Rikan_Kateen_and_Heta_Kol.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ri'kan Kateen and Heta Kol discuss abandoning Ruhnuk.]]
Upon exiting hyperspace, Ri'kan did not lose faith in Heta's cause and reminded her that regardless of the result, the Hidden Chain's cause is just and that Heta will see them through to the end. Then he then told Heta of a weapon that Sa'har told him about which prompted Sa'har to intervene at which Ri'kan emotionally blackmailed her telling her that she promised to help them. When Heta moved to talk to Sa'har he added that even Malgus covets the weapon which further adds significance to it and was visibly angry that Heta confided with Sa'har in secret while being ordered to not disturb them.<ref name="showdown" />

===Heta's New Plan===
[[File:Rikan_Kateen_and_Sahar_Kateen_after_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ri'kan and Sa'har in the aftermath of Ruhnuk]]
After Ruhnuk, Ri'kan was busy focusing on a holomap while Sa'har walked in and levitated a holopad with the Force to Ri'kan's annoyance which he demanded that she stop that. Sa'har encourages Ri'kan to try it as he has the power to when he replies that it wasn't what "her" Jedi friend said to which Sa'har says that she is the one telling him that he can do it. Ri'kan tries to use the Force but it doesn't work, and he grows frustrated he pulls out a dagger which he destroys the holopad with. He then tells Sa'har that this was the same dagger Heta used to liberate him as a slave and he has his own future such as becoming a Mandalorian was the greatest thing to ever happen to him while, unknown to both of them, Ri'kan was moving the holopad with the Force, albeit slightly.<ref name="old wounds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Odessen}}</ref>

{{GameLS}}
[[File:Rikan_Kateen_in_Chains_in_the_Dark.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ri'kan overseeing the next stage of Heta's plan]]
Ri'kan watched silently as Heta addressed the Hidden Chain of how the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|events on Ruhnuk]] were to be blamed on [[Bask Sunn]], that the [[Dar'manda]] were their new enemy and that [[Darth Nul's holocron]] will be their new trump card against [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]. Ri'kan became furious when Heta did not include him in her new inner circle, which included just her and Sa'har. When the Hidden Chain left, Ri'kan stormed off, unaware that he violently touched the holopad with the Force.<ref name="old wounds" />
{{Endgame}}

===Defeat===
[[File:Rikan_Kateen_in_Desperate_Defiance.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ri'kan faces off against Sa'har and the Commander.]]
Ri'kan was stationed on board the [[Hidden Chain flagship|ship]] where [[Darth Nul's holocron]] and the [[Holocron Machine]], replicated from Nul's Temple on Elom, was located. In their attempt to steal the holocron, Ri'kan angrily confronted Sa'har and the [[Alliance Commander]] while telling his sister that she came back only to take everthing from him again as he readied himself for battle. Ri'kan activate the machine in hopes that it will kill both the Commander and Sa'har at the cost of his life but it failed and managed to knock Ri'kan off the platform only to be rescued by Sa'har. While the Commander claimed the holocron, this left the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] siblings stuck as. Due to the machine overloading, the ship was destroyed.<ref name="sundering" />

===Resurface===
[[File:Rikan_captures Sahar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ri'kan with a captured Sa'har.]]
[[Darth Jadus]] discovered that Ri'kan survived the destruction of the [[Hidden Chain flagship]] and returned to the Hidden Chain with his prisoner: his sister, [[Sa'har Kateen]], for her [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|treachery]]. Jadus later relayed this information to the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

With his sister fitted with [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stuncuffs]] and a [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]], Ri'kan transported his sister on a [[Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle|''Scorpion''-class Intercept Shuttle]]. While in transit, Ri'kan initially ignored Sa'har's questions on why he didn't let her go or what her fate would be. When she pressed the issue, he replied that she betrayed Heta, who would be the one to decide her fate. He went on to declare that Sa'har was responsible for her own downfall, saying that she gave up the holocron like it was nothing or everything he had done was nothing. He then asked why her motivations for betraying him, only to be stunned to hear her admit that it was to save him. She then rose to tell him that no matter what loyalty or strength he gave to Heta, she would discard him. She acknowledged his anger towards her but promised that no matter what happened, she would never leave her behind again.<ref name="Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|Odessen}}</ref>

Later arriving on Heta's flagship, Ri'kan brought Sa'har to the bridge to face the Hidden Chain leader, boldly announcing he had brought the traitor to her. But as he was about to ask what fate she intended for his sister, suddenly Heta punched him in the stomach and kicked him in the back as he fell down. Sa'har was then electrocuted unconscious for protesting. As Hidden Chain soldiers drew their blasters on the Twi'leks, Heta drew her knife on Ri'kan, stating that she only saw one traitor in chains, and expressed her disappointment with Ri'kan for failing her so spectacularly. Ri'kan pleaded his loyalty, only to be told by Heta that she she only cared for victory, and accused his sister of negatively influencing him. However, in spite of his failings, she stated that Nul's machine is nearly complete. As she spared him, she promised that once she had reclaimed the holocron, he would have one last chance to prove his worth to the Hidden Chain. Briefly glancing towards his unconscious sister, Ri'kan then rose to his feet and bowed, prompting his comrades to lower their weapons. Subsequently, he was witness to Darth Jadus, Heta's benefactor, contacting the ship, asking the Field Marshal if she was ready to accept his offer.<ref name="Enigma" />

===Battle of Khar Shian===
Ri'kan joined Heta on [[Khar Shian]] as they met Jadus within the [[Naga Sadow's fortress|fortress]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], where the Hidden Chain had built a large scale version of Nul's machine. After [[Darth Rivix]] inserted the holocron into the machine, Jadus curbed Heta's impatience by insisting they test the device by using Sa'har. Ri'kan initially hesitated until Heta ordered him. As he pushed his sister towards the machine, she pleaded him not to let her captors do this to her. As she urged him to escape, Jadus' acolytes telekinetically forced her into the machine's seat. Ri'kan could only watch helplessly as the machine powered up and began electrocuting Sa'har. He then turned to Heta, questioning why his Field Marshal was aiding Jadus, reminding that she taught him that Sith were untrustworthy slavers, but she slapped him in response and ordered him to be silent. Unwilling to watch his sister in pain any further, Ri'kan punched a nearby Hidden Chain soldier and stole his spear and tried to breach the energy field surrounding Sa'har. As Jadus' acolytes charged him, Ri'kan let out a furious telekinetic wave, knocking everyone in vicinity of the machine off their feet and disrupted the energy field, freeing Sa'har. Heta quickly recovered, threw Ri'kan over her shoulder and tried to shoot him, but he dodged her shot and swiped her at with his knife, knocking her down. As he ran towards Sa'har, Rivix hit him in the back with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], only to be distracted by [[Tau Idair]] freeing herself and attacking the power console.<ref name="ITS">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Into the Shadows|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref> 

Initially, the Kateen siblings ran for the exit, only for Sa'har to become distracted seeing Idair holding off more acolytes. As the Jedi Knight urged Sa'har to flee, Ri'kan reminded her of their promise to never leave him again. Suddenly, three Hidden Chain soldiers took a shot at him, forcing Sa'har to use the Force to knock them down before hearing Idair repeat her order, at which the siblings fled.<ref name="ITS" />

Pursued by the Hidden Chain forces, the Kateen sibling made it to the outside of the fortress, where outside the shield, the Republic and [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] forces were engaging the Hidden Chain. A ''Scorpion''-class shuttle secretly piloted by the Alliance Commander had bypassed the shield and spotted the Kateen siblings. With more Hidden Chain waiting for them, the Commander shot at the soldiers on the ground, before they, [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Theron Shan]] bailed out after an anti-air turret shot them down. Sa'har then doubled back to aid the Commander against [[Shauz Farr]], ordering Ri'kan to ready the shuttle. After Shauz was killed, Ri'kan repeatedly called out to Sa'har, who took a moment to speak with the Commander before joining him. The siblings then boarded another ''Scorpion''-class shuttle and fled. However, as they were leaving Khar Shian, Sa'har heard Malgus using Nul's machine, calling to all those who could feel the Force as well as those who had forgotten their connection to tear down both the Jedi and Sith and seize the galaxy.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:RiKan_vibroaxe.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ri'kan Kateen's vibro-ax]]
Ri'kan Kateen was a fierce [[Mandalorian shock trooper]].<ref name="sundering" /> Although he was not as Force-sensitive as his sister,<ref name="Disorder" /> he became a powerful warrior. However, he could use the Force if he tapped into the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Ri'kan was an expert in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] combat, his weapon of choice was a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].<ref name="sundering" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ri'kan Kateen is first introduced in the [[Disorder]] cinematic for the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]] expansion. He is voiced by [[Matthew Mercer]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{c|credits}}</ref>

===Gameplay alternatives===
In '''Game Update 7.5: Desperate Defiance''', when Sa'har begs the player for help in pulling Ri'kan up, they have three options:
*If the player chooses the light side dialogue and helps save Ri'kan, Sa'har will immediately save Darth Nul's holocron before it is crushed by debris and hands it to the player, which Ri'kan wakes up to witness. As the player runs for the exit, Ri'kan will immobilizes Sa'har with the Force, forcing her to seal the exit to allow the player to escape. Ri'kan will then stand over a bare conscious Sa'har and roars furiously.<ref name="sundering" />
*If the player chooses the neutral dialogue, they will run for the holocron first. But as the player rushes to help Sa'har, a large piece of debris separates them. As the players leaves, believing the Twi'leks to be dead, it is revealed that Sa'har had in fact managed to pull up Ri'kan by herself and the two siblings stare into each other's eyes.<ref name="sundering" />
*If the player chooses the dark side dialogue, they will simply take the holocron and leave. Sa'har will then pull up Ri'kan by herself, narrowly avoiding being crushed by debris, leaving the two siblings to regard each other.<ref name="sundering" />
Regardless of which decision the player makes, both siblings eventually escape the Hidden Chain Flagship.<ref name="sundering" />

In the opening cutscene of '''Game Update 7.8: The Master's Enigma''', Sa'har and Ri'kan's dialogue may differ depending on the player's choices in Desperate Defiance.<ref name="Enigma" />

In '''Game Update 7.9: Legacy Reborn''', the player had two choices upon first spotting the Kateen siblings:
*If the player fires on the Hidden Chain, Sa'har will aid them in fighting Shauz Farr.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
*If the player chooses the dark side dialogue and fires on both Ri'kan and Sa'har, only to miss. The siblings would then board a shuttle without interacting with the player.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
